sessions.title: Capstone Quiz — Multiple Choice
sessions.what_learn: Prove what you learned across all five modules.

mechanism_map.learner_question: How does a request become a deployed website with no human team?
mechanism_map.product_promise: Turns a plain-language goal into a live, hosted service.
mechanism_map.observable_behavior: You describe a product; a working URL appears with code in a repo.
mechanism_map.mechanism: A planner decomposes the goal into a task backlog; an approval/autonomy gate promotes a task; a specialist agent works in a sandbox producing code + tests; a repo is created/updated; database and hosting are provisioned via authorized APIs; deployment yields a provider URL; logs and outcomes feed the next planning cycle.
mechanism_map.traditional_counterfactual: A PM writes a spec, eng builds, DevOps provisions and deploys — four handoffs across days.
mechanism_map.autonomy_boundary: Provider subdomains deploy automatically via pre-authorized accounts; custom domains, budget, and high-risk actions stay human-gated.
mechanism_map.failure_mode: A task can fail in the sandbox or at deploy; the system should surface the failure and hold the affected task rather than ship a broken build.

evidence.note: Public reference-implementation analogue (planner, queue, sandbox, GitHub, Neon Postgres, Render, public URL) — not proof of the private stack.

mechanism_map.learner_question: What keeps an autonomous agent from taking unsafe actions?
mechanism_map.product_promise: Automation acts only through pre-authorized accounts and policies.
mechanism_map.observable_behavior: Tasks pause at an approval gate before high-risk steps.
mechanism_map.mechanism: Credentials, budgets, and permissions are scoped per integration; the autonomy gate promotes only tasks within policy.
mechanism_map.traditional_counterfactual: An engineer manually holds credentials and runs each privileged step by hand.
mechanism_map.autonomy_boundary: Routine actions are automated; anything touching money, custom domains, or production data requires explicit approval.
mechanism_map.failure_mode: An over-broad credential scope could let an agent act beyond intent; policy scoping is the control.

evidence.note: Canonical treatment of agent guardrails and human intervention.

mechanism_map.learner_question: Is end-to-end autonomy actually reliable enough to trust?
mechanism_map.product_promise: The loop improves each cycle from tests, logs, and outcomes.
mechanism_map.observable_behavior: Failed tasks are retried or flagged; successful ones inform planning.
mechanism_map.mechanism: Test results, logs, and analytics are fed back into the next planning cycle.
mechanism_map.traditional_counterfactual: A team manually reviews CI and postmortems between releases.
mechanism_map.autonomy_boundary: The feedback loop is automated; the decision to trust it for high-stakes launches remains human.
mechanism_map.failure_mode: Silent quality regressions if evaluation signals are weak.

evidence.note: No independent benchmark of reliability located for this early-stage product.
